resources.string: See the outfit on you before you buy
Add your photo and a product link or garment image. ALMI_AI combines them into a realistic try-on image, then can animate the result.
Use a clear photo that shows your body and current pose.
Paste a product link or upload the garment image directly.
This store page could not be read. Upload the garment image instead.
The product page was found, but no usable image was detected. Upload the garment image instead.
Nothing is uploaded until you start generation.
AI is not configured. Open AI settings and activate a valid mode.
Automatic mode needs at least one connected OpenRouter key.
No free image-generation model compatible with try-on is currently available. Refresh later or activate a custom model.
The AI could not create the image. Check your connection, provider settings, balance or limits, and reference images, then try again.
This is a high-realism visual simulation. A single photo cannot guarantee physical garment measurements or fit to the millimeter.
Video generation failed. Your try-on image is still saved; you can retry the video.
Selected photos stay on your device until you press the AI generation button. At that point the required references are sent to the active provider for generation.
The entire interface and layout direction follow this choice.
Choose a clean light or dark theme, or follow the device.
Choose one active AI route: automatic routing or your custom provider.
Only one mode is active at a time. Automatic mode manages routing and key failover; Custom uses exactly what you enter.
ALMI_AI discovers compatible free routes, rotates connected keys, then falls back to the next model automatically.
Request order: best compatible model → first healthy encrypted key → next key if limited → next model if the route fails. Your custom model stays saved but is not used while Automatic mode is active.
No copy/paste required. Sign in to OpenRouter in your browser and ALMI_AI receives a user-controlled API key through OAuth PKCE.
OpenRouter connected. The new key was added to the encrypted device vault.
OpenRouter connection was not completed. Try again.
Keys are encrypted with Android Keystore and remain inside this ALMI_AI installation. Provider keys are not hardcoded into the APK.
Refreshes image and video capabilities from OpenRouter specialized model endpoints and keeps up to 30 candidates per media type.
Use a provider and media models you control. This mode bypasses automatic free routing.
The custom service must accept the same media request/response contract used by OpenRouter-style image and asynchronous video APIs. Technical IDs and URLs stay exactly as entered.
Custom provider saved and activated. Automatic mode is now off.
Automatically discovers compatible free media models and tries them in priority order.
While free mode is on, it is the only active AI route in ALMI_AI.
OpenRouter requires account authentication even for free models.

No explicitly free OpenRouter image-generation model with reference-image support is available right now. Automatic mode will detect one when the catalog changes; use Custom mode for image try-on meanwhile.
No compatible free video model was found in the current catalog.
Could not refresh the model catalog. Check your connection and connected key, then try again.
ALMI_AI keeps up to 30 compatible candidates per media type and moves automatically after a route failure.
ALMI_AI has its own Android identity and can be installed beside VibeApp.

ALMI_AI 0.2+ uses one fixed signed Release channel. After installing this channel once, later Release APKs update in place without uninstalling. An older experimental build signed with another certificate can require one final reinstall to enter this permanent channel.
